stage: After header/source acquisition and first failed freeze; before any external target numerical values were parsed
trigger: First freeze correctly stopped at duplicate gene-identifier validation
policy: Exclude every row carrying either duplicated gene identifier from each source matrix. No selection of a representative row, no averaging and no inspection of target numerical values. Apply identical ID-only rule before numeric QC/filtering in freeze and target evaluation. Stop on other duplicated identifiers or unexpected inventory.
analysis_change: Only resolves ambiguous feature identity. All transforms, thresholds, spans, donors, models, endpoints, positivity rules and sensitivity labels remain as in the original fixed protocol.
review: Independent design reviewer endorsed ID-only all-copy exclusion before target opening.
provenance: Save both original protocol and amendment hashes, source identifier inventory hashes and excluded IDs/counts in run records. This is a documented amendment, not part of the initial plan.
